positive_terms: Information about identity of administrative, management and supervisory bodies or individual(s) within body responsible for oversight of impacts, risks and opportunities
可持续监督责任机构和人员

Information about identity of administrative, management and supervisory bodies or individual(s) within body responsible for oversight of impacts, risks and opportunities。可持续监督责任机构和人员。治理机构成员不是员工总数；性别多样性和独立性分母、机构范围及统计时点必须明确。责任、能力和监督分别举证。
